# Digital Audio Resampling Home Page

![\resizebox{2in}{!}{\includegraphics{eps/SincSum.eps}}](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/img1.png)

### Abstract:

This document describes digital audio [sampling-rate conversion](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/) and
related concepts. [Open-source](http://www.opensource.org/) software is provided, and pointers are
given to related projects and papers.

**Detailed Contents (and Navigation)**

- [What is Bandlimited Interpolation?](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/What_Bandlimited_Interpolation.html)
- [Free Resampling Software](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Free_Resampling_Software.html)
- [Theory of Operation](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Theory_Operation.html)

  - [Abstract](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Abstract.html)
  - [Introduction](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Introduction.html)
  - [Theory of Ideal Bandlimited Interpolation](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Theory_Ideal_Bandlimited_Interpolation.html)
  - [From Theory to Practice](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Theory_Practice.html)
  - [Implementation](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Implementation.html)
  - [Quantization Issues](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Quantization_Issues.html)
    - [Choice of Table Size](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Choice_Table_Size.html)
    - [Linear Interpolation Error Bound](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Linear_Interpolation_Error_Bound.html)
    - [Application to the Ideal Lowpass Filter](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Application_Ideal_Lowpass_Filter.html)
    - [Relation of Interpolation Error to Quantization Error](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Relation_Interpolation_Error_Quantization.html)
    - [Error in the Absence of Interpolation](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Error_Absence_Interpolation.html)
    - [Choice of Interpolation Resolution](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Choice_Interpolation_Resolution.html)
    - [Quantized Interpolation Error Bound](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Quantized_Interpolation_Error_Bound.html)
    - [Ideal Lowpass Filter](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Ideal_Lowpass_Filter.html)
  - [Conclusions](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Conclusions.html)
  - [Appendix: Periodic Sinc Interpolation](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Appendix_Periodic_Sinc_Interpolation.html)
  - [Appendix: Relation between Sinc and Lagrange Interpolation](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Appendix_Relation_between_Sinc.html)

- [Bibliography](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/resample/Bibliography.html)
